Our Story

A Community of Family

More than just coffee - we're a movement that brings people together and supports our local farmers.

Founded on Purpose

In 2021, Arjay Borja, a former community organizer, pivoted to coffee roasting with a clear mission: to help local Capiz farmers find a market for their produce during the pandemic.

What started as a need became a movement. Today, OG Kopi operates 9 locations across Capiz and beyond, promoting our local Robusta beans and supporting the farmers who grow them.

OG Kopi Turns 5!

Five years ago, we made a promise to Capiz, that our coffee would never be forgotten, that our farmers would be seen, and that our land would get the recognition it deserves. Five years later, we're still here, still brewing with pride.

Thank you for every cup, every visit, every bit of trust. Here's to five more years of growing together! 🤍

Our Mission

More Than Just Coffee

OG Kopi was born from necessity and passion. In 2021, during the pandemic, Arjay Borja, a former community organizer, realized that local Capiz farmers needed a market for their coffee. He pivoted to coffee roasting not just as a business, but as a mission to elevate the local coffee industry.

Today, OG Kopi stands as a beacon for local coffee excellence. We celebrate Capiz-grown Robusta beans, host community cuppings to educate consumers, and create spaces where coffee brings people together as family.
